name: binary-real
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/real.bin" with data {1, -2.5, 300, 70000} as real
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/real.bin" as real

name: binary-real-big-endian
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/real-big.bin" with data {1, -2, 3} as real with big endian
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/real-big.bin" as real with big endian
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/real-big.bin" as real without big endian

name: binary-small-real
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/small-real.bin" with data {1, -2.5, 300, 70000} as small real
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/small-real.bin" as small real

name: binary-small-real-big-endian
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/small-real-big.bin" with data {1, -2, 3} as small real with big endian
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/small-real-big.bin" as small real with big endian
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/small-real-big.bin" as small real without big endian

name: binary-integer
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/integer.bin" with data {1, -2.5, 300, 70000} as integer
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/integer.bin" as integer

name: binary-integer-big-endian
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/integer-big.bin" with data {1, -2, 3} as integer with big endian
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/integer-big.bin" as integer with big endian
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/integer-big.bin" as integer without big endian

name: binary-small-integer
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/small-integer.bin" with data {1, -2.5, 300, 70000} as small integer
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/small-integer.bin" as small integer

name: binary-small-integer-big-endian
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/small-integer-big.bin" with data {1, -2, 3} as small integer with big endian
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/small-integer-big.bin" as small integer with big endian
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/small-integer-big.bin" as small integer without big endian

name: binary-byte
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/byte.bin" with data {1, -2.5, 300, 70000} as byte
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/byte.bin" as byte

name: binary-byte-big-endian
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/byte-big.bin" with data {1, -2, 3} as byte with big endian
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/byte-big.bin" as byte with big endian
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/byte-big.bin" as byte without big endian

name: binary-default-type
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/default.bin" with data {1.5, 2.5}
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/default.bin" as real

name: binary-append
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/append.bin" with data {1, 2} as small integer
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/append.bin" with data {3} as small integer
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/append.bin" as small integer

name: binary-starting-at
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/start.bin" with data {1, 2, 3} as byte
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/start.bin" with data {9} as byte starting at 1
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/start.bin" as byte

name: binary-starting-at-beyond
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/beyond.bin" with data {1} as byte
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/beyond.bin" with data {9} as byte starting at 3
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/beyond.bin" as byte

name: binary-array
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/array.bin" with data (createarray 5) as integer
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/array.bin" as integer

name: binary-skip
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/skip.bin" with data {1, 2, 3, 4} as small integer
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/skip.bin" as small integer skip 2

name: binary-length
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/length.bin" with data {1, 2, 3, 4} as small integer
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/length.bin" as small integer length 2

name: binary-step
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/step.bin" with data {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} as small integer
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/step.bin" as small integer step 4

name: binary-blocks
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/blocks.bin" with data {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8} as byte
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/blocks.bin" as byte step 4 blocksize 2

name: binary-blocks-length
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/blength.bin" with data {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8} as byte
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/blength.bin" as byte step 3 blocksize 2 length 2

name: binary-unsigned
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/unsigned.bin" with data {-1, -2} as small integer
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/unsigned.bin" as small integer without signed
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/unsigned.bin" as byte without signed
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/unsigned.bin" as byte with signed

name: binary-rounding
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/round.bin" with data {1.5, 2.5, -1.5, 1.4} as integer
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/round.bin" as integer

name: binary-out-of-range
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/range.bin" with data {300, -129, 1.0E+10} as byte
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/range.bin" as byte

name: binary-nan
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/nan.bin" with data (divlist {0, 1} with {0, 1}) as integer
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/nan.bin" as integer

name: binary-partial
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/partial.bin" with data {1, 2, 3} as byte
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/partial.bin" as small integer

name: binary-read-missing
script: read binary POSIX file "$TMP/no-such.bin" as real

name: binary-read-empty
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/empty.bin" with data {} as real
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/empty.bin" as real

name: binary-no-as
script:
write binary POSIX file "$TMP/noas.bin" with data {1}
read binary POSIX file "$TMP/noas.bin"

name: binary-bad-type
script: write binary POSIX file "$TMP/bad.bin" with data {1} as text

name: binary-no-data
script: write binary POSIX file "$TMP/nodata.bin"
